#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Install the iPhone profile and build fixes onto the pinned UniXNU checkout."""
import argparse,subprocess,shutil
from pathlib import Path
p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);p.add_argument('upstream',type=Path);a=p.parse_args();u=a.upstream.resolve();here=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(u),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
if head!='04573c510c5fd4892ca6948739389141cc9e05f5':raise SystemExit('Unexpected upstream revision')
patch=here/'upstream-build.patch'
if subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(u),'apply','--reverse','--check',str(patch)],capture_output=True).returncode:
 subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(u),'apply','--check',str(patch)],check=True)
 subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(u),'apply',str(patch)],check=True)
shutil.copytree(here/'upstream-overlay',u,dirs_exist_ok=True)
prelink=u/'kits/XnuPrelink'
revision=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(prelink),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
if revision!='b74ed7c74a07f0eb5f81089c660905ecc4cabb7f':raise SystemExit('Unexpected XnuPrelink revision')
layout_patch=here/'patches/xnuprelink/iphone-constant-prefix.patch'
if subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(prelink),'apply','--reverse','--check',str(layout_patch)],capture_output=True).returncode:
 subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(prelink),'apply','--check',str(layout_patch)],check=True)
 subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(prelink),'apply',str(layout_patch)],check=True)
print('Installed iPhone 24A446 profile and fileset layout patch; not boot qualified')

device/myron27/README.md.content:
# myron upstream iPhone iOS 27 integration

Target: Redmi K90 Pro Max / SM8850, iPhone iOS 27.0.1 (24A446), donor iPhone12,1/N104, arm64e.
Upstream: UniXNU/UniXNU at `04573c510c5fd4892ca6948739389141cc9e05f5`.
XNU: apple-oss-distributions/xnu at `ac9718fb1af618d5ce8678d0dc6e8a58f252216f`
(`12377.121.6`, with upstream Darwin 26 compatibility patches).

This is configuration/source migration, not a bootable release. `board.example`
blocks phone packaging; `kernel --skip-prelink` permits host-only compilation.
The older `kernel/myron` configuration and R90 release remain separate.

## Completed host work

- Upstream `unixnu status --json` selects arm64e, the 24A446 profile and the
  upstream architecture/OS patch chains. No XNU 10063 patch is selected.
- Board DTS compiles with the preserved myron RAM/GIC/CPU description.
- SM8850 Affinity2 and CCIDX patches are rebased against XNU 12377 source.
  All 70 selected patches now apply to the complete pinned XNU source.
  The iPhone boot-progress patch omits the optional sheng PMGR hook.
- The actual patched cache decoder passes existing UBSan host tests, including
  the recorded R52 register sample, legacy format, wide associativity and
  invalid/overflow rejection.

## Integration still required

1. Qualify PAC at EL1 and EL0 on every CPU that will be enabled. R90 arm64
   execution does not prove arm64e/PAC access through the firmware/hypervisor.
2. Reconcile the local ArmCpu override against the pinned upstream revision;
   compile all platform/PMGR/IRQ components with the new XNU headers.
3. Port the existing myron UFS transport and readonly root binding to the
   target storage ABI. Do not substitute SM8550 controller/PHY defaults.
4. Use the 24A446 kernelcache, DeviceTree, trust modules, OS and SystemOS images.
   Rebuild root policies and an appropriate Data seed. R90's 21H461 binaries,
   private offsets, trust bundle and image hashes are not inputs for this OS.
5. Integrate the arm64e display/HID/KeyStore components and the original
   fileset ABI. Do not copy the 21H461 display vtable offsets or GPU addresses.
6. Reconcile the myron UEFI loader, memory reservations and payload packaging
   with current DarwinBoot. Re-run the host handoff tests against new objects.
7. Complete full patch application, kernel build, LTO reference, prelink,
   package and boot-image checks before offering a phone test.

The 32 GiB `unixnu` partition remains an existing device resource. No partition
or image write is part of this source migration. Any new installation must
check actual image sizes and bind the existing partition GUID; upstream sheng
userdata examples must not be applied to Android userdata.

## Reproduce current checks

From the pinned UniXNU checkout (`DEVICE` is this directory):

```sh
./unixnu status --json -D "$DEVICE"
python3 "$DEVICE/verify_migration.py" --upstream "$PWD" --xnu /path/to/xnu-12377
dtc -I dts -O dtb -i "$DEVICE/../sm8850/dts" \
  -o /tmp/myron27-hardware.dtb "$DEVICE/dts/myron.dts"
```

The resolved component catalog is a source/version plan, not evidence that all
components have been fetched, built or run. Keep `example = true` until phone integration is implemented. Native host
compilation is supported independently of phone-image qualification.

References: https://github.com/UniXNU/UniXNU/pull/155 and upstream
`docs/zh/porting/arm64e.md`, `docs/zh/porting/migration.md`.

## iPhone target and current build result

The Apple BuildManifest and decompressed DeviceTree identify iPhone12,1,
N104/N104AP, ApChipID 0x8030 and ApBoardID 4. All four extracted components
are SHA256-pinned in the new OS profile. The decompressed kernelcache is an
arm64e MH_FILESET with 243 entries. iPad root UUIDs, kext roots, AMFI addresses
and regression-policy pins have been removed rather than reused.

Linux target propagation and compiler-rt now follow the selected architecture
and deployment target. Actual Mach-O probe objects verify arm64/iOS17 remains
arm64 and arm64e/iOS27 produces subtype 2 with iOS 27 deployment. Four existing
kernel staging tests pass. Full native compilation was attempted and reached
libfirehose after header generation, where the retained Clang 24 rejects the
fourth __ptrauth parameter, "authenticates-null-values". This ABI behavior is
not removed. check_compiler.py reproduces the missing feature before building.

The Apple-toolchain CI input is .ci/myron27-macos.yml with a complete hashed
source snapshot. The job first builds the native kernel, then independently checks UFS source,
an LTO reference and strict iPhone prelink. A successful job is not evidence
that UFS root, display, or SpringBoard is running.

The second macOS attempt passed the compiler feature check and compiled the
kernel and selected components, then failed final linking with missing
`source_corecrypto14_original` and `source_corecrypto14_start_once`.
The inherited `prelinked` mode undefines `XNU_SOURCE_CORECRYPTO14` only for
`prng_random.o`, removing both definitions while OSKext still references them.
The iPhone target now selects upstream `source` bootstrap mode and rejects
the incompatible setting before compilation. This restores the real early
provider initialization and its start-once helpers, including the original
fileset-provider preference and full POST; it does not substitute stubs or
skip crypto checks. Full native linking passed in run 41566051862; runtime POST still requires verification.

ArmCpu is rebased to upstream 93a5030c with the new processor-registration
ordering and bootInitialized guard. Darwin assembly newline delimiters and
the SGI probe's corrected operands are retained in the iPhone device override;
the older myron/SM8850 driver remains unchanged.

## Verified macOS native build (2026-11-03)

Run [41566051862](https://github.com/yuwenhua653/UniXNU/actions/runs/41566051862),
remote commit `b20ce1f5610cc4225a699dfd3ed4669383ae92a0`, passed the final link.
Downloaded artifact 13199357291 has SHA256
`6bd0430368170445d03ab7c7231b82c4b527fbf3371b2389b611c70725b9716a`.
The actual 25,715,656-byte native kernel matches the CI SHA256 and has arm64e
subtype `0xc0000002`, iPhoneOS platform 2, minimum OS 27.0, no undefined
symbol-table entries, and all four real crypto bootstrap definitions.
The bootstrap-pass missing `_corecrypto_kext_start` message is followed by
archive generation and a successful final link; it is not a final build failure.

Run `python3 verify_native_artifact.py /path/to/extracted-artifact` to repeat
these checks. This checks native Mach-O evidence only. The empty prelink
segments, disabled UFS/display configuration and unchanged `board.example`
mean this artifact is not a phone firmware. The following real-input checks identified changes needed before prelink.

## Desktop integration: real-input blockers (2026-11-03)

The pinned 24A446 donor decompresses to 67,534,848 bytes, SHA256
`813be26ab6bd1d8de211904eca413a1a2ebf79989f90c33a48ff0f2fcff99036`.
The selected 30 iPhone roots resolve to 38 retained entries. The missing
iPad-only IOHIDEventDriver root is not requested; IOHIDFamily is retained.

Actual strict prelink of the verified native artifact first rejected a
constant-segment overlap. Native DATA_CONST plus LASTDATA_CONST needs 0x120000
bytes, but the first retained constant starts at offset 0x11a4c8. The layout
patch borrows 0x6000 bytes of unused preceding PRELINK_TEXT tail using the
native 4 KiB granule, preserving retained driver addresses and the 16 KiB
chained-fixup page format. It refuses occupied or noncontiguous spans. All
63 XnuPrelink unit tests pass, including four new layout regression tests.

The real-input retry passed layout and stopped because the old standalone
kernel lacks split-segment relocation records. The target now enables
CONFIG_XNU_KERNEL_CHAINED_FIXUPS; the artifact verifier requires both
split-segment v2 and chained-fixup commands before prelink. This configuration
change requires a new native build. The old artifact fails the new gate as
expected; enabling the option alone is not evidence the new build passes.

The same CI job will compile the existing myron UFS transport against pinned
public storage headers, build the upstream RELEASE LTO comparison kernel,
fetch/hash the iPhone donor components, and attempt strict prelink without
missing-call stubs. Every independent stage records its result even if another
fails. The comparison kernel is never a boot candidate. UFS compilation does
not bind or qualify the original storage family's private ABI. No old absolute
addresses or iPad ABI anchors are added. Logs, source/object digests, and
prelink metadata are retained; original Apple IPSW components are not uploaded
as CI artifacts. Phone packaging and partition writes remain disabled.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Probe the compiler ABI features required by XNU 12377 arm64e before a long build."""
import argparse,json,subprocess,struct
from pathlib import Path
p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);p.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True);a=p.parse_args();a.out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
s='''#if !__has_builtin(__builtin_xnu_type_summary)
#error XNU type summary builtin is required
#endif
struct slot { void * __ptrauth(2, 1, 0, "authenticates-null-values") value; };
void *load(struct slot *p) { return p->value; }
void store(struct slot *p, void *q) { p->value = q; }
'''
obj=a.out/'compiler-probe.o';args=['xcrun','--sdk','iphoneos','clang','-target','arm64e-apple-ios27.0','-mkernel','-Werror','-c','-x','c','-','-o',str(obj)]
r=subprocess.run(args,input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);(a.out/'compiler-probe.log').write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr)
version=subprocess.run(['xcrun','clang','--version'],capture_output=True,text=True)
report={'command':args,'compiler':version.stdout,'compile_passed':r.returncode==0,'phone_tested':False}
if r.returncode==0:
 header=struct.unpack_from('<8I',obj.read_bytes());report['arm64e_object']=header[0]==0xfeedfacf and header[1]==0x100000c and header[2]&0xffffff==2 and header[3]==1
else:report['error']=r.stderr
(a.out/'compiler-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if report.get('arm64e_object') else 1)

device/myron27/build_native.py.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Host-only XNU build from pinned local references; never creates a phone boot image."""
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('--upstream',type=Path,required=True)
p.add_argument('--references',type=Path,required=True)
p.add_argument('--xnu',type=Path,required=True)
p.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True)
p.add_argument('-j',type=int,default=4)
a=p.parse_args();sys.path.insert(0,str(a.upstream.resolve()/'scripts'))
from unixnu.cli import parser,cmd_defconfig
from unixnu.config import Context
from unixnu import feeds,tree,kernel
from unixnu.util import Error
base=['-D',str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent),'--out',str(a.out.resolve()),'-j',str(a.j)]
c=Context(parser().parse_args(['defconfig','myron27_defconfig',*base]));cmd_defconfig(c)
c=Context(parser().parse_args(['kernel','--skip-prelink',*base]));modules=feeds.resolve(c)
if c.need_config().get('XNU_CRYPTO_BOOTSTRAP') != 'source':
 raise Error('myron27 requires source crypto bootstrap: prelinked mode removes helpers still used by XNU 12377 OSKext')
if c.need_config().get('XNU_KERNEL_CHAINED_FIXUPS') is not True:
 raise Error('myron27 desktop integration requires XNU_KERNEL_CHAINED_FIXUPS=y')
for (kind,name),m in modules.items():
 if kind!='refer' or name=='edk2':continue
 m.path=a.xnu.resolve() if name=='xnu' else a.references.resolve()/name
 expected=m.source['commit'];actual=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(m.path),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
 if actual!=expected:raise Error(f'{name}: expected {expected}, got {actual}')
 m.commit=actual
for m in modules.values():
 if m.path and m.kind in ('driver','kit') and m.origin=='base':
  expected=next(s['revision'] for s in c.component_specs if s['id']==m.name)
  actual=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(m.path),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
  if actual!=expected:raise Error(f'{m.name}: wrong pinned component')
tree.assemble(c,modules)
kernel.build(c,modules)
kernel.prelink(c)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Apply the complete pinned patch series and test its CCIDX decoder."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

UPSTREAM = "04573c510c5fd4892ca6948739389141cc9e05f5"
XNU = "ac9718fb1af618d5ce8678d0dc6e8a58f252216f"
FILES = (
    "osfmk/arm/cpuid.c", "osfmk/arm/machine_cpuid.c",
    "osfmk/arm/cpuid_internal.h", "osfmk/arm64/start.s",
    "osfmk/arm64/machine_routines.c",
)


def run(args, cwd=None):
    return subprocess.check_output([str(x) for x in args], cwd=cwd)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--upstream", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--xnu", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    device = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    upstream, xnu = args.upstream.resolve(), args.xnu.resolve()
    for path, expected in ((upstream, UPSTREAM), (xnu, XNU)):
        if run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], path).decode().strip() != expected:
            raise SystemExit(f"Wrong source revision: {path}")
    status = json.loads(run([upstream / "unixnu", "status", "--json", "-D", device]))
    assert status["board"]["os"]["arch"] == "arm64e"
    assert status["board"]["os"]["xnu_revision"] == XNU
    assert status["board"]["board"]["example"] is True
    assert not any("10063" in p for p in status["patch_order"])
    applied = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="myron27-audit-") as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)
        run(["git", "clone", "--quiet", "--shared", xnu, root])
        for name in status["patch_order"]:
            patch = Path(name)
            run(["git", "apply", patch], root)
            applied.append(patch.name)
        assert "native-smp-wide-affinity.patch" in applied
        assert "arm64-ccidx-cache-geometry.patch" in applied

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile the existing myron transport for arm64e; never bind legacy ABI offsets."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
import tomllib


def module(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    result = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(result)
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--tree', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--upstream', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--out', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    tree, upstream, out = args.tree.resolve(), args.upstream.resolve(), args.out.resolve()
    here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    profile = tomllib.loads((here/'upstream-overlay/profiles/os/ios-27.0.1-24A446-iphone12-1/profile.toml').read_text())
    os.environ.update(UNIXNU_XNU_ARCH='arm64e', UNIXNU_IOS_VERSION='27.0')
    builder = module('driver_builder', upstream/'scripts/build-sheng-source-drivers.py')
    target = module('myron_target', upstream/'scripts/kernel_target.py')
    headers = module('storage_headers', upstream/'scripts/prepare-storage-headers.py')
    storage_pin = next(s['commit'] for s in profile['source'] if s['name']=='IOStorageFamily')
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    header_report = headers.prepare(tree/'refer/IOStorageFamily', storage_pin, out/'headers')
    recipe = tree/'build/xnu/ios-obj/DEVELOPMENT_ARM64_BCM2837/iokit/DEVELOPMENT/IOPlatformExpert.cpo.json'
    record = json.loads(recipe.read_text().strip().rstrip(','))
    target.check_object((Path(record['directory'])/'IOPlatformExpert.cpo').read_bytes(), 'kernel recipe')
    source = here.parent/'sm8850/drivers/NativeUfs/MyronUfsProbe.cpp'
    pins = json.loads((source.parent/'UPSTREAM.json').read_text())
    for entry in pins['files']:
        path = source.parent/'upstream'/entry['path']
        if path.is_file():
            data = path.read_bytes()
            if hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(data)).encode()+b'\0'+data).hexdigest()!=entry['sha']:
                raise ValueError(f'Vendored UFS source changed: {path}')
    output = out/'MyronUfsProbe.o'
    command = builder.compile_command(record, source, output,
        ['-I', str(out/'headers/include')],
        ['-DMYRON_ROOT_POLICY=0', '-Wno-missing-designated-field-initializers', '-Wno-error'])
    (out/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(command, indent=2)+'\n')
    with (out/'compile.log').open('w') as log:
        subprocess.run(command, cwd=record['directory'], stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
    target.check_object(output.read_bytes(), 'myron UFS source')
    dependencies = {}
    deptext = output.with_suffix('.d').read_text().replace('\\\n', '')
    for name in shlex.split(deptext.split(':', 1)[1]):
        path = Path(name)
        if not path.is_absolute(): path = Path(record['directory'])/path
        dependencies[str(path.resolve())] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    imports = sorted(builder.nm(output, '-u'))
    report = dict(target=target.TRIPLE, compile_pass=True, source_pin=pins['commit'],
        storage_headers=header_report, object_sha256=hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        undefined_symbols=imports, dependencies=dependencies,
        legacy_absolute_bindings_added=False, kernel_linked=False, root_published=False,
        runtime_qualified=False)
    (out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
    print('PASS myron UFS arm64e source compilation; family binding remains pending', flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__': main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build comparison/transport inputs and perform strict iPhone fileset prelink.

No missing-call stubs, legacy absolute addresses, phone packaging or device I/O.
Independent host checks finish even if another check fails; the summary records
each result and any failed check makes this command fail.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tomllib


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--upstream', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--work', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--out', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    upstream, work, out = args.upstream.resolve(), args.work.resolve(), args.out.resolve()
    tree = work/'tree'
    here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    sys.path.insert(0, str(upstream/'scripts'))
    from unixnu.ipsw import Ipsw, kernelcache
    from verify_native_artifact import verify
    profile_path = here/'upstream-overlay/profiles/os/ios-27.0.1-24A446-iphone12-1/profile.toml'
    profile = tomllib.loads(profile_path.read_text())
    summary = dict(target=profile['os']['name'], stages={}, phone_firmware=False, boot_verified=False)
    summary_path = out/'desktop-integration.json'
    def save(): summary_path.write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2)+'\n')
    def stage(name, action):
        try:
            value = action()
            summary['stages'][name] = dict(passed=True, result=value)
            print('PASS', name, flush=True)
            return True
        except (Exception, SystemExit) as error:
            summary['stages'][name] = dict(passed=False, error=str(error))
            print('FAIL', name, str(error), flush=True)
            return False
        finally: save()
    def run(name, command, env=None):
        (out/(name+'-command.json')).write_text(json.dumps(list(map(str,command)),indent=2)+'\n')
        with (out/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:
            subprocess.run(list(map(str,command)), cwd=tree, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
    if not stage('native-prelink-input', lambda: verify(work/'kernel', require_prelink=True)):
        raise SystemExit('Native kernel cannot be prelinked; see desktop-integration.json')
    stage('ufs-source', lambda: run('ufs-source', [sys.executable,here/'build_ufs_source.py',
        '--tree',tree,'--upstream',upstream,'--out',out/'ufs']))
    env = dict(os.environ, UNIXNU_IOS_VERSION='27.0', UNIXNU_XNU_DARWIN=profile['os']['darwin'],
               UNIXNU_XNU_VERSION=profile['os']['xnu_version'], XNU_KERNEL_CHAINED_FIXUPS='1')
    reference = tree/'build/xnu/fileset-reference/mach.release.bcm2837.unstripped.noctf'
    reference_ok = stage('release-lto-reference', lambda: run('release-lto-reference',
        [sys.executable, upstream/'scripts/build-fileset-release-reference.py','--tree',tree,'--lto'], env))
    class Context:
        board = profile
        out_root = out
        def option_text(self, *unused): return None
    def fetch():
        source = Ipsw(Context())
        for component in profile['ipsw']['fetch']:
            path = source.extract(component)
            expected = profile['ipsw']['sha256'][path.name]
            if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=expected:
                raise ValueError(f'IPSW input digest mismatch: {component}')
        cache = kernelcache(Context(),source)
        summary['kernelcache'] = str(cache)
        return {'sha256':hashlib.sha256(cache.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'bytes':cache.stat().st_size}
    ipsw_ok = stage('iphone-inputs', fetch)
    if reference_ok and ipsw_ok:
        command = [sys.executable,upstream/'kits/XnuPrelink/emit_prelink.py',
            '--kernel',work/'kernel/kernel.macho','--prelinked',summary['kernelcache'],
            '--fileset-reference',reference,'--slide=0','--output',out/'prelinked/kernel.macho']
        for root in profile['kernel']['prelink']['roots']: command += ['--root',root]
        (out/'prelinked').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        stage('strict-prelink',lambda:run('prelink',command))
    else:
        summary['stages']['strict-prelink'] = dict(passed=False, skipped='missing reference or iPhone input')
    summary['all_host_stages_passed'] = all(s['passed'] for s in summary['stages'].values())
    save()
    if not summary['all_host_stages_passed']:
        raise SystemExit('Desktop integration incomplete; all independent stage logs preserved')


if __name__=='__main__': main()
